claims.A62: GitHub's Pages documentation states that when a site is published from a custom GitHub Actions workflow no CNAME file is created, so the custom domain is a repository setting rather than a file in the deployed artifact.

prereg.question: Does the public GitHub Pages docs page on managing a custom domain say that an Actions-published site gets no CNAME file? (S18 showed a snippet; this records the sentence under its own claim.)
prereg.expect_if_true: phrase 'no CNAME file is created' found=True, with context mentioning publishing from a custom GitHub Actions workflow.
prereg.expect_if_false: The phrase is absent or the context contradicts it (S3-29 must add the CNAME file to the deploy artifact instead of using the repository setting). A fetch error is inconclusive: re-run under a new id.
